ai_summary: A2ZINFRA Engineering Limited has re-appointed Mr. Amit Mittal as its Managing Director cum CEO for a three-year term effective January 1, 2027, ensuring continuity of experienced leadership (35+ years in infrastructure) to drive strategic direction and growth. A key governance point disclosed is that Mr. Mittal's spouse, Ms. Dipali Mittal, serves as a Non-Executive Non-Independent Director, indicating a related-party relationship within the board that warrants attention for potential conflicts of interest.
